content.comment_body: Hello, If possible, I would like to join this discussion since I am trying to do something similar. I have a 0-10V output from the [product_name] AM2 module connected to the 0-10V input of an inverter. My goal is to display the inverter frequency value in the range of 0-50Hz. I can post my program when I get to the office, if that's alright. Thanks, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user wishes to scale a 0-10V control signal to represent a 0-50Hz frequency and display this value. The user is unsure whether the current [company_name] product setup is optimal for this purpose or easy to implement. No errors are reported, but guidance on effective scaling and display of the signal is requested.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to easily convert a 0-10V analog signal into a 0-50Hz frequency value and display this using [company_name] [product_name] hardware and its associated software.
